Event · September 2026

UNESCO Global Forum on the Ethics of AI

At the fourth UNESCO forum in Riyadh, I listened to how countries and organisations were putting AI ethics into practice. I left thinking about who is accountable once AI starts shaping real decisions.

Read event summary about UNESCO Global Forum on the Ethics of AI

I went to the fourth UNESCO Global Forum on the Ethics of AI expecting something closer to LEAP. I thought I would spend most of the day seeing what the latest tools could do. Instead, I listened to people from governments, international organisations, research and industry work through what should happen when those tools are put to use. It was the first edition of the forum held in the Gulf. UNESCO reported more than 10,000 participants and delegations from over 50 Member States across the event in Riyadh.

Two-day workshop · NY Empire Academy

Lead & Influence: Negotiation and Communication Workshop

I completed the two-day Essentials Workshop, practising public speaking and negotiation through exercises and simulations.

I worked on making a point clearly, then listening for what the other person needed before deciding where there was room to negotiate.

Volunteering · Al-Rowad International Schools · May 2025

Graduation ceremony volunteering

I helped set up the ceremony, seat guests and support backstage logistics as a student volunteer.

I worked alongside staff and other students before guests arrived and during the ceremony. Moving between the guest area and backstage showed me how much a smooth event depends on clear handovers and good timing.

Events & conferences

Event · September 2026

Money20/20 Middle East

I explored agentic commerce and how a company can tell whether an AI agent has permission to make a purchase for someone.

Read event summary

Money20/20 brought banks, fintech companies and technology providers together in Riyadh. I went to see how the AI systems I had been following were being used in financial services. I attended a session on agentic commerce and walked through the exhibition, where payment companies and identity and security providers were working on different parts of the same problem.

Read full write-up about Money20/20 Middle East

Technology event · 2026

LEAP Riyadh

I saw robots, autonomous delivery vehicles and palm-based payments demonstrated, and considered what it would take to use them every day.

Read event summary

LEAP’s 2026 edition brought startups, established technology companies and investors to Riyadh. I spent time with the exhibits on robotics, autonomous transport and new ways to pay. I also tried an F1 simulator and learned about the Saudi Arabian Grand Prix.

Cybersecurity event · December 2025

Black Hat Middle East & Africa

I attended cybersecurity workshops and briefings in Riyadh and completed ten hours of continuing professional development.

Read event summary

Black Hat MEA brought security researchers, practitioners and technology providers together for workshops and briefings. I joined sessions on emerging threats and approaches to defending systems. I completed ten hours of CPD activities and received a certificate for ten CPD credits.

Aviation event · December 2025

Global Airports Forum

I spoke with aviation professionals about airport operations and acquired a metal collectible from a retired Emirates Airbus A380.

Read event summary

The forum brought airport operators, technology providers and aviation professionals to Riyadh. I met people working across different parts of the industry and heard how they manage airport operations. A short boarding delay offered a useful example. It can affect gate availability, baggage handling and the aircraft’s next flight, so several teams may need to adjust their plans together.
